component.name: ROIFT GUI
component.summary: Seed-based ROIFT segmentation for 3D medical images

description.p: ROIFT GUI is a Qt6/VTK/ITK desktop application for segmenting 3D medical volumes. It opens NIfTI, DICOM series and NumPy arrays, shows axial, sagittal and coronal slices alongside a 3D mask render, and lets the user place object and background seeds by hand. The bundled ROIFT command-line tools turn those seeds into per-label segmentations, which are merged back into an editable multi-label mask.
